notes.title: Knowledge Base and Bugfix – Patch 2.0.6
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a link to our knowledge base guides on the help page.
[*] Fixed an error when using long intervals.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Translations – Patch 2.0.5
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Translations updated for multiple languages.
[*] Updated support page visual.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Changes - Patch 2.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added an option to minimize the app while capturing click locations, images, and colors. This is now the default behavior, but you can disable it in the Configuration tab.
[*] Updated the help page with more information, especially for advanced mode, and added a search bar.
[/list]

notes.title: Toggle, Labels, and More - Patch 2.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Labels for blocks in advanced mode.
[*] Toggle to enable/disable blocks in advanced mode.
[*] Option to return the cursor to its original position after executing move blocks.
[*] Recording timer and playback counter.
[*] Feature detection mode for image detection.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where using mass edit with a large number of blocks could cause lag or crash the app.
[*] Fixed an issue where rapidly expanding and collapsing a custom block containing many blocks could cause an error.
[/list]

notes.title: Detection Capture Tools, Movement Recording, and Profile Copy - Patch 2.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Image capture for detection blocks.
[*] Color picker for detection blocks.
[*] Custom color matching mode.
[*] Gradual movement to move blocks.
[*] Drag functionality to move blocks.
[*] Option to record mouse movement without actions.
[*] Profile copy feature.
[/list]

notes.title: Color Detection, Move Blocks, and More - Patch 2.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a move block to move the cursor without clicking.
[*] Added a color matching feature for detection blocks.
[*] Improved compatibility with multiple monitors.
[*] Added a support tab with contact information.
[/list]

notes.title: Recording Adjustments - Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

Enhanced the recording functionality to register multiple keys held simultaneously.

The following changes were required for the recording improvements and have been included in Advanced Mode:

[list]
[*] Added DOWN and UP options for keys and clicks.
[*] Added an option to execute drags in parallel.
[/list]

notes.title: Random Options - Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Random Block - You can now use the random block in advanced mode to execute a random block within.
[*] Added random offsets to click, scroll, and key locations.
[*] Added random offsets to hold durations for clicks and key presses.
[/list]

notes.title: Mouse Scroll and Bug Fixes - Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added "Scroll Block" to simulate the mouse wheel in advanced mode and recordings.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Removed the mass edit button from Custom Block when nothing is selected, as it was causing crashes.
[*] Fixed an issue where the window remained hidden when loading data from a higher resolution to a lower one.
[*] The language is now updated immediately when changed, without needing to restart the app.
[/list]

notes.title: Detected point offset and other fixes - Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] In image detection, you can now add a fixed offset to the detected point location to adjust it if you don't want the click to happen at the center of the detected area.
[*] Copied blocks now appear below the original block instead of at the end of the list.
[*] Fixed a bug where profile names/keys would not save correctly when updated.
[/list]

notes.title: Edit All Blocks Button and Profile Bug Fixes - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added an option to quickly update all blocks inside. You can now quickly change the Move Cursor option and Interval.
[*] Fixed a bug where using the same custom block in multiple profiles caused visual duplication of blocks.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Changes - Patch 0.3.3
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The window size and position are now saved for when you reopen the app.
[*] Fixed a bug where dragging a custom block into itself would cause crashes. This is no longer possible.
[*] Added more information to the Help page.
[/list]

notes.title: Relative Position and Copy Functionality - Patch 0.3.2
notes.content:
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a copy button for blocks and macros.
[*] You can now use the "Window" relative position to base click coordinates on the window rather than the screen. This ensures that clicks occur in the same position, even if the window is moved.
[/list]
[h1]Recording Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added the relative position feature, similar to Advanced Mode.
[*] Added an option to record the cursor position when a key is pressed.
[/list]

notes.title: Profiles - Patch 0.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added profiles to advanced mode to make it easier to configure for multiple games/apps.
[*] Added an option to make the mouse move gradually before clicking.
[/list]

notes.title: Drag Click - Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added drag click functionality to Advanced Mode and Recording Mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Start Configurations and Small Fixes - Patch 0.2.9
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added side button forward and back as options for click.
[*] Now you can separate the keys to start/stop for Standard, Advanced, and Recording modes.
[/list]
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug where display values of the same custom block in a loop would not update after editing.
[*] Fixed incorrect text in the interval and repeat blocks.
[/list]
[h1]Recording Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now key durations are also recorded when using the "Record hold duration" option.
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial Videos - Patch 0.2.8
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added tutorial videos to the Help tab.
[/list]

[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where clicks would fail when multiple parallel loops executed them simultaneously.
Note: Hold clicks will still block other clicks, as it's not possible to click in two places at once.
[/list]

notes.title: Parallel Loops - Patch 0.2.7
notes.content:
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added an option to have multiple parallel loops in advanced mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Dark Mode and Key Inner Blocks - Patch 0.2.6
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added dark mode.
[*] Removed text selection outside of input fields.
[/list]

[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added option to hold key for the duration of the inner blocks.
[*] Fixed bug where blocks inside detection block would not reorganize properly.
[*] Fixed bug where custom blocks would minimize after every update.
[/list]

notes.title: Configuration Options - Patch 0.2.5
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added option to separate start and stop keys
[*] Added option to minimize app to system tray
[/list]

notes.title: Move cursor on Key Block - Patch 0.2.4
notes.content:
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added option to move the cursor when using Key Blocks in advanced mode.
[/list]

notes.title: CPS display and Macro changes - Patch 0.2.3
notes.content:
[h1]Standard Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added CPS estimation display value in the Standard Interval to help configuration.
[/list]
[h1]Advanced Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Key Block now has a hold duration configuration
[*] Option to set hold binding to macro and configure if it can execute simultaneonusly.
[/list]

notes.title: Mouse and hold bindings - Patch 0.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added some mouse buttons to the bindings and included the option to set a hold bind that executes only while holding the button.
[/list]

notes.title: Macros - Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now you can create macros in advanced mode to assign custom blocks to execute when a key is pressed.
[*] Recording indicator moved to the sidebar.
[/list]

notes.title: New UI - Patch 0.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the UI to change the logo and better fit the color scheme.
[*] Now you can expand custom blocks by clicking on them and edit them in the main loop.
[/list]

notes.title: Hold mouse button - Patch 0.1.8
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now you can select the 'Hold' click type to keep the mouse button pressed for a specific amount of time.
[*] Added a record hold option to recordings.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievements - Patch 0.1.7
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added steam achievements integration.
[/list]

notes.title: Image detection and UI changes - Patch 0.1.6
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] UI adjustments.
[*] Fixed image detection to work with transparent pixels in PNG files.
[/list]

notes.title: Data Management - Patch 0.1.5
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] An option has been added to export, import, and clear data in the configuration tab. Now you can save multiple configurations and easily share them with others.
[/list]

notes.title: Localization - Patch 0.1.4
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now you can select the app language in the configurations tab. Currently, only English and Portuguese have been fully revised; all other languages have been automatically translated. I'll work on revising them in the future, but you can also assist by reporting any mistranslations you notice in the Community Tab.
[/list]

notes.title: Enable Key Modifiers - Patch 0.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now there's support for key modifiers for Key Blocks and Recordings.
[/list]

notes.title: Region of interest and other tweaks - Patch 0.1.1
notes.content:
[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now you can select a region of interest for image detection, reducing the area to search and improving processing speed.
[*] Added more information to the help page.
[*] UI improvements.
[/list]
[h1]Recording Mode Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a move cursor toggle.
[/list]

notes.title: Recording Feature - Patch 0.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Recording Feature[/h1]

[list]
[*] Now you can press the recording button, or press the recording key, to start recording all your clicks, keypresses and the interval between them.
[*] You can also create a custom block using the recording to use it in the advanced mode.
[/list]

[h1]General Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Bottom layout bar buttons adjusted.
[*] Added info to help page.
[/list]

notes.title: Interval improvements and other tweaks
notes.content:
General Changes

[list]
[*] Improved interval accuracy.
[*] Added an option to click without moving the mouse cursor (the click might not register on some applications that check the cursor position).
[*] Fixed a bug where the clicker would not stop during the double-click delay.
[*] Added more information to the help page.
[/list]

Advanced Mode Changes

[list]
[*] Added a page with all custom blocks for easier management.
[/list]

notes.title: Standard Mode Tweaks
notes.content:
[h2]Standard Mode Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added toggle for interval.
[*] Added configurable delay between fixed and image-find clicks.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Advanced Mode Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added custom blocks.
[*] Improvements on key block so it works on more applications.
[*] Fixed bug where main loop would not save correctly.
[*] Fixed bug when using multiple detection blocks.
[/list]
